primary_endpoint.no_paired_t_test_confirmatory_reason: All five models are evaluated on the exact same locked-test cohort, violating independent observations assumption required for confirmatory t-inference.

confirmatory_reference.decision_rule: Confirmatory success requires that the lower bound of the 95% source-cluster bootstrap CI of the aggregate Macro-F1 across the 5 Stage 1 N=250 checkpoints is strictly greater than 0.5000 (CI_lower > 0.5000). If CI_lower <= 0.5000, conclude lack of confirmatory evidence exceeding reference.

confidence_interval_specification.pairing_rule: When a unique source_id is resampled with replacement, both the authentic and ai_edited paired samples associated with that source_id are jointly preserved in the resampled replicate.
algorithm_steps: 1. Resample 343 unique source_ids with replacement using RNG seed 20261002.
2. For each of the 5 fixed checkpoints, compute Macro-F1 on the reconstructed paired test set (686 samples).
3. Compute the arithmetic mean of the 5 Macro-F1 scores for that replicate.
5. Sort the 10,000 aggregate Macro-F1 scores and take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles as the 95% CI.
